=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27062-27114 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the run_standalone_stall_recovery auto_approve and retrigger_implement arms, the new `_stall_route_open_impl_pr` call runs before `_plan_auto_approval_gate`, and the gate is skipped for any routing result other than rc 1. This bypasses the heal_counterfactual_hold path at lines 20398-20409: the STALL_SKIP log, `_heal_stale_close_check` at 20405 and `_heal_counterfactual_hold_notify` at 20407. It also bypasses the protected-path hold and the Q108 grant write.
  WHY: A held workflow-heal issue with an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR now gets a review dispatch with `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT=true` / `took_action=true` instead of staying held. CI on head 36dc0e4 (run 44645371836) fails tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr (line 32549; assertion at 32556 expects `HEAL_STALE_CLOSE issue=501 outcome=kept reason=open_pr`) in orchestrate-poll shard 1 and tests-system-python shard 21. That test is not in the inherited-failure list, and the aggregate lint check fails as a result. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20735-20829 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the execute_stall_recovery_action auto_approve arm (~20738-20748) and retrigger_implement arm (~20811-20821), the routing `case` returns before the existing holds run. Those holds are the staged-support latch skip (`_staged_support_comments_for_guard` / `_staged_support_latch_release_incomplete`, 20758-20774) and `_plan_auto_approval_gate` (20777-20780 / 20822-20831), which includes heal_counterfactual_hold, the stale-close check and the protected-path hold.
  WHY: With the flag at its default (on), an orchestrator-managed issue that is in the latch window or has a held plan, and has an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR, gets a review dispatch and a counted recovery attempt instead of being skipped. This breaks "with the flag unset, everything that runs today ... keeps running unchanged". Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated MAJOR with confidence 4, the other reviewers rated BLOCKER with confidence 5; the highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Never put an existing path behind it: with the flag unset, everything that runs today (releases, tagging, dispatches, merges) keeps running unchanged." The issue also scopes the change to replacing the `/approved` post: "when the issue already has an open implementation PR, do not post /approved; dispatch review on the PR". Source: linked issue #9809. The PR acceptance criteria also require the existing test suite to stay green.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the auto_approve / retrigger_implement arms of run_standalone_stall_recovery (lines 27054-27134) and execute_stall_recovery_action (lines 20725-20860). The routing call belongs inside the gate's approval branch, immediately before the `/approved` heredoc.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk keeps `_plan_auto_approval_gate` running ahead of the new routing; that gate includes the heal_counterfactual_hold STALL_SKIP, `_heal_stale_close_check`, `_heal_counterfactual_hold_notify` and the protected-path hold. In the managed auto_approve arm, no hunk keeps the staged-support latch skip ahead of the routing either. The gate runs only on routing rc 1 in all four arms. The pre-existing test tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr fails in CI on the PR head (orchestrate-poll shard 1, tests-system-python shard 21, run 44645371836). The ordering asserts in tests/test_stall_existing_impl_pr_routing.py (test_stall_arms_route_before_posting_approved and test_standalone_stall_arms_route_before_posting_approved) still assert `route < body.index("_plan_auto_approval_gate")`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27062-27074, 27096-27113 (run_standalone_stall_recovery auto_approve / retrigger_implement arms) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_stall_route_open_impl_pr "${issue_num}" "${phase}" "${action}" || _std_auto_approve_route_rc=$?` runs first. The gate only runs `if [ "${_std_auto_approve_route_rc}" -eq 1 ] && _plan_auto_approval_gate ...`, and in retrigger_implement `if [ "${_std_retrigger_implement_route_rc}" -ne 1 ]; then _std_rti_gate_ok="false"` skips the gate at 27109. Every routing result other than rc 1 therefore skips the gate's heal_counterfactual_hold branch (lines 20398-20409: the STALL_SKIP log, `_heal_stale_close_check` at line 20405 (#8808) and `_heal_counterfactual_hold_notify` at line 20407). It also skips the automation-path / protected-path hold and the Q108 grant write.
  WHY: A held workflow-heal issue with an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR now gets a review dispatch, `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT=true` and `took_action=true`, and the stale-close check never runs. CI on head 36dc0e431ac8 fails tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr (lines 32549-32558, assertion at 32556) in orchestrate-poll shard 1 and tests-system-python shard 21. The test is not inherited, and the aggregate `lint` check fails. Suggested fix: call the routing only inside the gate-approved branch, immediately before the `/approved` heredoc, and update test_standalone_stall_arms_route_before_posting_approved to require gate < route < `/approved`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20738-20748, 20811-20821 (execute_stall_recovery_action auto_approve / retrigger_implement arms) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The routing `case` returns before `_staged_support_comments_for_guard` / `_staged_support_latch_release_incomplete` (lines 20758-20774) and before `_plan_auto_approval_gate` (lines 20777-20780 and 20822-20831). It returns 0 (dispatch, counted) or 1 (rc 2/3), so the latch skip, heal_counterfactual_hold with its stale-close check, and the protected-path hold are all bypassed.
  WHY: With the flag at its default (on), a managed issue in the latch window or with a held plan, and with an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR, gets a review dispatch and a counted recovery attempt. This breaks "with the flag unset, everything that runs today ... keeps running unchanged". Suggested fix: keep the no-op cap, the latch and the gate in their current order, put the routing just before the `/approved` post, and update test_stall_arms_route_before_posting_approved, which currently asserts `route < body.index("_plan_auto_approval_gate")`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Never put an existing path behind it: with the flag unset, everything that runs today (releases, tagging, dispatches, merges) keeps running unchanged." Also: "when the issue already has an open implementation PR, do not post /approved; dispatch review on the PR".
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh. In run_standalone_stall_recovery, the auto_approve and retrigger_implement arms (lines 27054-27134). In execute_stall_recovery_action, the auto_approve and retrigger_implement arms (lines 20725-20860).
  Evidence of absence: No hunk keeps the existing holds ahead of the new routing: `_plan_auto_approval_gate` (heal_counterfactual_hold STALL_SKIP, `_heal_stale_close_check`, `_heal_counterfactual_hold_notify`, the protected-path hold) and, in the managed auto_approve arm, the staged-support latch skip. test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr fails in CI on the PR head.
- Note (not a finding): the last-run change adds `|| true` to `impl_reason` in unblock_resolve_implementation_pr (scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 1895). The reviewer judged it harmless. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:execute_stall_recovery_action (managed arm) and run_standalone_stall_recovery (standalone arm) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new routing call `_stall_route_open_impl_pr` is placed before the existing stall-recovery and stale-close checks, including `_heal_stale_close_check`.
  WHY: Whenever an open implementation PR exists, the pipeline bypasses existing safety and stall-healing logic. This violates the requirement to keep existing paths running unchanged and causes CI test failures (e.g., `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py::test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr`).
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Never put an existing path behind it: with the flag unset, everything that runs today (releases, tagging, dispatches, merges) keeps running unchanged."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, specifically the `execute_stall_recovery_action` and `run_standalone_stall_recovery` logic arms.
  Evidence of absence: The test failure `test_standalone_heal_stale_close_keeps_with_open_refs_linked_issue_branch_pr` shows that the existing stale-heal check, which should have produced "HEAL_STALE_CLOSE issue=501 outcome=kept reason=open_pr", was bypassed by the new routing logic.

The test is not inherited. The previous editor's run-4 rejection was about the no-op cap (20728-20737/20801-20810), a different code path from the actual defect.

  Requirement: "Never put an existing path behind it: with the flag unset, everything that runs today (releases, tagging, dispatches, merges) keeps running unchanged." (issue #9809, Change / Gate section). The acceptance criteria also require the existing test suite to stay green.
